title: TV signal down after gunfire, explosions heard across Niger's capital
summary: National television service was cut in Niger on Saturday after a night of gunfire and explosions reported by residents in the capital Niamey, including around a military base near an international airport that was attacked twice this year by rival jihadist groups.
contentText: Niger's junta said Saturday it was back in control after mutineers held soldiers hostage at a military base next to the capital's airport. Russian forces reportedly helped members of Niger's presidential guard recapture the air base, killing some of the mutineers, according to diplomatic and security sources.
